# Ariel Mirra

> Senior Software Engineer at Salesforce (MuleSoft), working on API-modeling infrastructure and AI-native developer tooling

I'm a Senior Software Engineer at Salesforce (MuleSoft), where I own AMF, an open-source API-modeling framework consumed by 10+ downstream products. I led the AMF foundation of a platform-wide OpenAPI 3.1/3.2 initiative: release 5.11.0 added OAS 3.2, AsyncAPI 3.0/3.1, JSON Schema 2020-12, GraphQL V2 and gRPC/proto3 in a single month, without breaking downstream products.

I also build AI-native developer tooling. My suite of agentic AI (Claude Code) automation skills, adopted by the team, cut our multi-repo release pipeline from 5 days to 2-3 days, sped up API-spec adoption ~10x, brought Gov/FedRAMP security review from 3-4 hours to 30 minutes and saves 4+ hours per incident on RCAs.

My primary stack is Scala, Java, Kotlin, Go and TypeScript. Outside Salesforce working hours I run CoderHub, a career-mentorship business I founded in 2023 that has closed 100+ clients.

## Experience

- Senior Software Engineer (SMTS), Salesforce (MuleSoft) (Jan 2025 - Present)
- Software Engineer (MTS), Salesforce (MuleSoft) (Aug 2022 - Feb 2025)
- Software Engineer (AMTS), Salesforce (MuleSoft) (Apr 2021 - Aug 2022)
- Software Engineering Intern, Salesforce (MuleSoft) (Oct 2019 - Apr 2021)
- Founder, CoderHub (Jan 2023 - Present)
- Profesor de Emprendedurismo e Innovación, Universidad Austral, Buenos Aires (Jan 2023 - Present)
- Software Developer / Frontend Developer, Sirius Systems S.A.S. (Feb 2018 - Mar 2019)

## Projects

- [AMF (API Modeling Framework)](https://a.ml/docs): Open-source API-modeling framework consumed by 10+ products. Release 5.11.0 added OAS 3.2, AsyncAPI 3.0/3.1, JSON Schema 2020-12, GraphQL V2 and gRPC/proto3 support in one month, plus a ~45-page Docusaurus documentation site.
- anypoint-project-builder: Public npm package and OCLIF CLI extension for end-to-end OpenAPI 3.1/3.2 generate/validate workflows.
- Agentic AI (Claude Code) automation skills: Internal tooling adopted team-wide: multi-repo release automation (5 days to 2-3 days), API-spec adoption tooling (~10x faster), Gov/FedRAMP security review automation (3-4 hours to 30 minutes) and incident RCA acceleration (4+ hours saved per incident).

## Stack

Scala, Java, Kotlin, Go, TypeScript, Spring, GraphQL, OpenAPI, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Claude Code
